'''chris_engler Tibannas Give Me Gas (Dark Side)''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[chris_engler]]
* '''Published:''' 2 October 2004 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Special Edition]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hoth: Wampa Cave (7th Marker)|Hoth-D-hothwampacave.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Hoth: Wampa Cave (7th Marker)
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PSE HWC7M chris engler DS 2004 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

I haven't played this DS Tibanna Gas Miners deck yet. Let me know how to improve it!

The published list has 59 cards.

== Notes ==

* Qty 59 as published, counting Hoth: Wampa Cave twice: it is listed as the starting location and again under Locations (a unique site; probably the same card listed twice). Without the repeat the list is 58.
* No objective; starts Hoth: Wampa Cave (7th Marker). Ghhhk x3 is the single Interrupt.

== Strategy ==

Basically, the strategy here is to deploy your gas miners to locations that the light side can't (all the sites have zero light side icons). Then, deploy systems, clouds, and cloud cars to make your miners drain away.

I have the weapon-equipped characters in there to protect the gas miners against Nabrun Leids and/or spies.

Biggest weakness I see is low destiny (16 cards with zero) but this deck isn't designed for combat. I did a few sample turns and was able to drain for 8 by round 3.

What would improve it?
